local DATUM = wf.vars.json.IDOC.ZCDF_HEAD.DATUM
local TIME = wf.vars.json.IDOC.ZCDF_HEAD.TIME
local year = string.sub(DATUM, 1, 4)
local month = string.sub(DATUM, 5, 6)
local day = string.sub(DATUM, 7, 8)
local hour = string.sub(TIME, 1, 2)
local min = string.sub(TIME, 3, 4)
local sec = string.sub(TIME, 5, 6)
return string.format('%s-%s-%sT%s:%s:%s.00000Z', year, month, day, hour, min, sec)

local function ensureArray(t)
  if type(t) ~= 'table' then return {t} end
  local isArray = true
  for k, _ in pairs(t) do
    if type(k) ~= 'number' or math.floor(k) ~= k then isArray = false break end
  end
  return isArray and t or {t}
end

local dt = wf.initVariables.recallTime
if not dt then return nil end
local y,m,d,h,min,s,sign,oh,om = string.match(dt, '(%d+)-(%d+)-(%d+)T(%d+):(%d+):(%d+)([+-])(%d+):(%d+)')
if not y then return nil end
local epoch = os.time({year=y, month=m, day=d, hour=h, min=min, sec=s})
local offset = (tonumber(oh) * 3600) + (tonumber(om) * 60)
if sign == '+' then epoch = epoch - offset else epoch = epoch + offset end
return epoch
